documents.title: RFP — Northfield Council — order management
documents.content:
RFP — Northfield Council — order management

1. Describe your hosting arrangements.
2. Is your service ISO 27001 certified?
3. Can orders be exported in bulk?
4. Describe your data retention.
5. Provide your pricing for 40 users over three years.

documents.title: RFP answers — 2026-06
documents.content:
RFP answers — 2026-06

Q4 Hosting: Acme Orders runs on servers in the EU (Frankfurt) with a second region in Dublin; data does not leave the EU. Daily backups are kept for 35 days.
Q5 Retention: Order data is kept while the account is open and for 60 days after closure, then deleted.
Q9 Pricing (2026-04, a council): $38 per user per month on a three-year term.
Q11 Export: Any order list can be exported as CSV from the Orders page.

documents.title: Security
documents.content:
Security (2026-10)

## Certifications
Our hosting provider holds ISO 27001; Acme Orders itself is not certified.

## Retention
Order data is kept while the account is open and for 90 days after closure, then deleted; backups age out after 35 days.

documents.title: Help
documents.content:
Help

## Exporting orders
Orders → Export, top right, gives a CSV of the current filter.
